description: Edit this sheet of six small chibi pixel art figures sitting on the ground: in the top row one sits facing the viewer, one sits facing away from the viewer, one sits facing the viewer with the hands at the chest; in the bottom row one sits facing the viewer with the hands at the mouth and two sit facing away. Dress every figure in the same outfit and change nothing else: keep each figure's pose, size, place, bald head, ears and face exactly as they are, with the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour. The outfit is a pumpkin king's: a fitted deep violet coat with long sleeves to the wrist and a short flared hem, embroidered with curling orange pumpkin vines and green leaves, closed down the front with round orange buttons shaped like little carved pumpkin faces, an orange sash at the waist, an orange-and-black striped knee-length skirt over black stockings, and black boots with big brass buckles. Seen from behind, the coat's back shows the vine embroidery and no buttons. Nothing of the outfit reaches lower than each seated figure's own lowest pixels, which stay exactly where they are. The hands stay bare and keep their place. Transparent background, nothing else added.
